pictures.scene: Raphael, The Vision of Ezekiel — the Lord borne up in the opened sky on the living creatures with the earth lying small and bright below, the LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice
pictures.name: pd_raphael_regeert

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Transfiguration — Christ standing in the white blaze with His arms spread while the disciples fall back dazzled, clouds and darkness surround Him and righteousness is His throne's foundation
pictures.name: pd_angelico_wolken

pictures.scene: Benjamin West, Destruction of the Beast and the False Prophet — the rider going out in the flame of heaven while his enemies are swept down before him, fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side
pictures.name: pd_west_vuur

pictures.scene: Thomas Cole, Tornado in an American Forest — the great trees torn and bent under the black storm with the light breaking behind them, His lightning illuminates the world and the earth trembles
pictures.name: pd_cole_bliksem

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, Mount Vesuvius at Midnight — the mountain running with fire into the dark bay, the mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_bergen

pictures.scene: Abraham Hondius, The Annunciation to the Shepherds — the sky torn open over the fields with the angel calling down to the startled herdsmen, before the Lord of all the earth the heavens proclaim His righteousness
pictures.name: pd_hondius_hemel

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Fall of the Rebel Angels — the bright angels driving the rebels down out of the light into their own shapes, all the peoples see His glory and the worshipers of images are put to shame
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_beelden

pictures.scene: Albrecht Dürer, The Adoration of the Trinity — the whole company of heaven and earth kneeling around the cross held up by the Father, worship Him, all you gods
pictures.name: pd_durer_goden

pictures.scene: Salomon van Ruysdael, View of Deventer — the river town with its church tower and windmills standing clear under a wide sky, Zion hears and rejoices and the towns of Judah exult
pictures.name: pd_ruysdael_sion

pictures.scene: Domenico Fetti, Salvator Mundi — Christ on the clouds with His hand raised and the globe under His other hand, You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth
pictures.name: pd_fetti_hoogste

pictures.scene: Pieter Aertsen, Christ Cleansing the Temple — Christ reaching across the money table and turning the traders out of the courts, You are exalted far above all gods; hate evil, O you who love the LORD
pictures.name: pd_aertsen_kwaad

pictures.scene: Sebastiano Ricci, The Liberation of Saint Peter — the angel taking the sleeping apostle by the wrist and leading him past the guards, He preserves the souls of His saints and delivers them from the hand of the wicked
pictures.name: pd_ricci_bewaart

pictures.scene: Aelbert Cuyp, Herdsmen with Cows — the herdsmen resting with their cattle in the long golden light of the river bank, light shines on the righteous and gladness on the upright in heart
pictures.name: pd_cuyp_licht

pictures.scene: Hendrick Cornelisz van Vliet, Interior of the Oude Kerk in Delft — the great organ standing at the end of the sunlit nave with the people gathered below it, rejoice in the LORD and praise His holy name
pictures.name: pd_vliet_verblijdt

lines.text: The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice;
let the distant shores be glad.
Clouds and darkness surround Him;
righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.
Fire goes before Him
and consumes His foes on every side.
His lightning illuminates the world;
the earth sees and trembles.
The mountains melt like wax
at the presence of the LORD,
before the Lord of all the earth.
The heavens proclaim His righteousness;
all the peoples see His glory.
All worshipers of images are put to shame—
those who boast in idols.
Worship Him, all you gods!
Zion hears and rejoices,
and the towns of Judah exult
because of Your judgments, O LORD.
For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth;
You are exalted far above all gods.
Hate evil, O you who love the LORD!
He preserves the souls of His saints;
He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
Light shines on the righteous,
gladness on the upright in heart.
Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones,
and praise His holy name.
